review.purpose: Synthesize German dialogue for video 1/5 after its GPU transcription and translation
review.reason: Render German speech using a consistent Supertonic preset per detected speaker
review.input: GPU results for new_guys/Bill Ackman_ Is Permanent Capital an Investor’s Biggest Edge_ _ Podcast _ In Good Company_1080p_en_129kbps.mp4, preflight first 15 seconds and full workload; includes pitch estimates from longer turns for the two detected speakers
review.outputs: video_00.cpu_v2_preflight and video_00.cpu_v2_full M4A and JSON timing reports under modal_control/batch_inputs; previous attempt retained
review.quality_tradeoffs: Speaker presentation from pitch and diarization can be wrong. Unassigned translated cues use maximum overlap with diarized English cues and that inference is recorded. Cues without evidence fail. Consecutive speaker cues are grouped; available pauses are used and FFmpeg tempo filters are chained as needed to fit speech before the next cue. Very fast spans may sound unnatural; each rate is recorded. M1 and M2 are estimates, not voice clones.
review.cost_estimate: Actual cost unknown; two 7200-second deadlines, 4 CPU and 16 GiB RAM, plus applicable storage and egress. Not a billing cap.
